chapter_title_en: The Kunpeng and the Ancient City
chapter_seo_title: World of Immortality Ch.520: The Kunpeng's Wrath and the Ancient City
chapter_meta_description: Five Ancestral Gods face the legendary Kunpeng, which fights to the death, wounding one of them. Xiao Chen glimpses a fragment of the formation diagram, and Keke senses her family's power. An ancient city of terror awaits.
og_title: Chapter 520: The Kunpeng's Wrath and the Ancient City of Antiquity
og_description: The Otherworld Ancestral Gods battle the suicidal Kunpeng and discover they are traveling backwards in time. Keke's family legacy looms as a colossal ancient city appears, shaking even the Ancestral Gods' resolve.
twitter_description: Five Ancestral Gods fight the mythic Kunpeng, wounded by its self-destruction. A fragment of the formation diagram appears. Keke senses her kin. A terrifying ancient city emerges.
